Section.Title: The ECS structure
Section.Paragraph: Components store data. Queries select entities. Systems process them. Events expose changes. Each cell below runs in an independent World.

Section.Title: 1. Components and views
Section.Paragraph: An entity is a composition of components. Generated views update those components and dispatch the corresponding events.

Section.Title: 2. Queries and systems
Section.Paragraph: A matcher defines the component shape a system accepts. A stage gives systems an explicit execution order.

Section.Title: 3. Events and triggers
Section.Paragraph: A matcher selects the entities; a trigger selects the event. A generated view writes the value, then dispatches the change.

Section.Title: 4. Bundles and commands
Section.Paragraph: A bundle defines a reusable component set. A command names a mutation and can also be observed as an event.

Section.Title: 5. World addons
Section.Paragraph: An addon is a World-owned service. Its lifetime starts and ends with that World.

Section.Title: 6. Ordered systems
Section.Paragraph: A SystemChain keeps execution order explicit. Here, two spawners run twice and add four entities.
